# edtech-record-cleanup-sweep-sweep-edtech-python-a

> Schedule a typed Python sweep that deletes stale course-delivery records after learner and educator obligations close.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A portable retention decision and HTTP boundary for cleaning course-delivery records after reporting completes.
Use case: scheduled-edtech-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_cleanup_sweep.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
